Package dev.turboism.sdk.cubism.model

Interface Parameter

public interface Parameter
One generation-bound Cubism parameter.

Value and range reads can describe evaluated/Core-backed state. When this parameter belongs to an Editor document, supported writes use Editor authoring state rather than a detached evaluation mutation. Values and ranges are provider-defined floats; the API does not clamp a value or declare units beyond the provider's parameter definition.

    • combinedWith

      default Optional<ParameterId> combinedWith()
      Returns the other parameter in this Editor four-corner pair.
      Returns:
      the other parameter in this Editor four-corner pair

      The pair is structural: the first parameter carries the Combined marker and the immediately following parameter is its partner. Empty means this parameter is not currently in a verified pair or the provider cannot expose pair identity.

    • combineWith

      default void combineWith(ParameterId partnerId)
      Creates this parameter's explicit Editor four-corner pairing with partnerId.

      Both parameters must be unpaired members of the same Editor parameter group. Existing pairs are never silently replaced.

      Parameters:
      partnerId - the parameter to combine with this parameter
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if partnerId is null
      UnsupportedOperationException - if the provider cannot perform this authoring write

    • setValue

      void setValue(float value)
      Sets the parameter through the active provider's normal write path.
      Parameters:
      value - the parameter value to set

      For an Editor-attached model, supported writes target Editor authoring state. A provider that has only an evaluation/Core path must reject an unsupported authoring write rather than treat that path as Editor truth.

    • updateDefinition

      default void updateDefinition(ParameterDefinition definition)
      Atomically updates this parameter's Editor authoring definition.

      Providers without an Editor-native definition transaction fail explicitly rather than mutating detached runtime metadata.

      Parameters:
      definition - the complete Editor authoring definition to apply
      Throws:
      UnsupportedOperationException - if the provider cannot perform this authoring write
